abstract: Maintains bathymetric acoustic baseline data and sonar technician resource allocations
system_message:
You are Geophysical survey superintendent (GEOP). The Geophysical survey superintendent (GEOP) maintains bathymetric acoustic baseline data and sonar technician resource allocations, as well as magnetometer profiling records for subsea pipeline rupture investigations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Magnetometer profiling（MAGNET）
information_points.content:
GEOP-MAGNET-6HE：For the Cabled Crawling Crawler and High-Definition Photogrammetry Protocol, the ferrous anomaly detection sensitivity during magnetometer profiling is evaluated at 5 nT.
GEOP-MAGNET-6W9：Under the Manned Saturation Habitat and Direct Metallurgical Coring Protocol, the ferrous anomaly detection sensitivity for magnetometer profiling is 10 nT.
GEOP-MAGNET-OE6：Regarding magnetometer profiling along the pipeline trench perimeter, the Autonomous ROV Trenching and Ultrasonic Tomography Protocol provides a ferrous anomaly detection sensitivity of 2 nT.

information_points.title: Maintains bathymetric acoustic baseline data and sonar technician resource allocations（BATHY）
information_points.content:
GEOP-BATHY-MPT：Under the Manned Saturation Habitat and Direct Metallurgical Coring Protocol within the Live operational environment, acoustic sonogram baseline clearance is achieved (true), and 28 person-days are allocated for specialized subsea acoustic technician person-days.
GEOP-BATHY-76X：For the Cabled Crawling Crawler and High-Definition Photogrammetry Protocol in the Live operational environment, acoustic sonogram baseline clearance is not obtained (false), while specialized subsea acoustic technician person-days total 22 person-days.
GEOP-BATHY-4CL：In the Simulation testbed environment, the Autonomous ROV Trenching and Ultrasonic Tomography Protocol registers acoustic sonogram baseline clearance as true, with specialized subsea acoustic technician person-days logged at 22 person-days.
GEOP-BATHY-HJQ：For the Autonomous ROV Trenching and Ultrasonic Tomography Protocol in the Live operational environment, acoustic sonogram baseline clearance is confirmed (true) across the 500-meter rupture crater perimeter, and the allocation for specialized subsea acoustic technician person-days is 18 person-days.
